rules.sentence: Tricuspid regurgitation is the most common indication requiring tricuspid valve repair.

Due to convincing evidence available now that untreated severe tricuspid regurgitation results in a worsened outcome, there is an increased interest in the treatment of sole tricuspid valve pathologies.
Study results have shown that tricuspid regurgitation is associated with a higher incidence of cardiac events and mortality in patients with congestive heart failure.
Research results indicate moderate to severe tricuspid regurgitation is associated with reduced survival rates.
